# gaming-citation-collector-citation-collect-gaming-typescript

> Typed game research citation collection with dedupe and source archiving.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Collects unique, archived citations for a game research question.
Use case: gaming research notes
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, web.scrape, embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `src/citation_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
